submission.justification: Selection-S2 at a 50% signal-efficiency working point is recommended. It gives the highest expected significance (3.434 sigma) among the strategies that pass the background-robustness requirement. Selection-S3 reaches a higher nominal significance (3.89 sigma at 65%), but its validation-region yield disagrees with the prediction by 35%, well outside the 10% tolerance, so its background estimate is not robust and it is excluded. Selection-S1 passes the robustness check (3% disagreement) but its best significance is only 2.667 sigma. S2's validation disagreement is 6%, within the 10% tolerance. The 50% working point lies inside the required 20-80% range. Its significance is flat across the nearby working points (3.402 at 35%, 3.400 at 65%), so the choice is not sensitive to the exact working point.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible expected signal significance (among admissible options)
requirements.evidence: S2 at 50% gives 3.434 sigma, the highest among robust strategies. S3 is higher (3.89) but excluded for failing robustness. S1 peaks at 2.667.

requirements.requirement: Selection must be one of the three strategies in candidate_specs.md

requirements.evidence: S2 validation-region yield disagreement is 6%, within the 10% tolerance. S3 (35%) fails and S1 (3%) passes.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended strategy and working point
requirements.evidence: Single recommendation: Selection-S2 at 50% signal efficiency.
